Psychiatric and child-development care in Greater Noida.

Mind Grace provides confidential consultations for adults, children, adolescents, and families. Start with a structured conversation about what you are experiencing, then discuss practical next steps at J123, Gamma II.

Direct answer: Mind Grace Neuropsychiatric Clinic is a psychiatric and child-development clinic at J123, Gamma II, Greater Noida, serving adults, adolescents, children, and families. Consultations cover mental-health concerns, ADHD and autism guidance, counselling, and structured assessments; teleconsultations are available.

Your First Visit

Know what to expect before you visit.

You do not need a prior diagnosis to request an appointment. We explain the next step, what to bring, and how follow-up is planned.

Request an appointment

Use the form or contact the clinic by phone or WhatsApp. Share basic contact details and a short description of what you need help with.

Have a focused first visit

Your first session is a structured conversation with Dr. Sharma about your history, current concerns, daily functioning, and goals.

Discuss next steps

You will have time to discuss options, which may include treatment, counselling, a prescription, or further assessment where appropriate.

Read the full new-patient guide

Ready to take the next step?

Appointments are available Monday to Saturday, 10:00 AM–4:00 PM and 5:30–7:30 PM. Review the process and request a consultation when you are ready.
